behavioral_effects: None stated. An empty list is a claim that nothing observably changes.
compatibility_impact: None. No runtime code, schema, HTTP interface, WebSocket event, or environment variable changed; governance sync reported no bytes changed. The skills reference two existing contracts without altering them - the embedding dimension/fingerprint agreement in policies/compatibility.json and the mandatory Next.js proxy hop - and instruct agents to check them rather than weaken them.
reason: Recurring operations (governed change, refactor, RAG change, full-stack endpoint, debt sweep) were re-derived by hand each session, so the governance envelope and the proxy-hop and embedding-dimension gates were applied inconsistently. Encoding them as skills makes the envelope the default path rather than a remembered one, and a router skill keeps agents from picking the wrong chain.
rollback: Delete the six directories under .claude/skills/: gov-change, pick-workflow, refactor-governed, rag-change, endpoint-fullstack, debt-sweep. No migration, persisted state, or generated artifact is involved; removal is complete and immediate.
security_impact: None. The skills are prompt-only markdown with no executable code and grant no permissions or tool access. They restate existing policy rather than relaxing it: secrets never committed, connector credentials Fernet-encrypted at rest, security-review named as a required cross-cutting pass for auth/secrets/MCP/user-input work. No validators.json entries were added, so no new command surface is introduced, and google-live-e2e is documented as deliberately excluded from automated selection.
summary: Add six agent-workflow skills that chain prompt commands inside the governance envelope
